answer: Each epoch, every node commits a willow-scoped state root: its own Blake3 hash over a dedicated 16 GB RAM array filled with per-node unique nonces, so no two identities share a digest. Verifiers then sample the knoll of roots, checking hashes match arrays replayable in 400 ms. A sybil spawning 10,000 keys must fund 160 TB of distinct RAM, roughly $96,000 monthly, since cloned arrays fail the replay. Failed hashes are evicted to a lagoon of discredited roots and the stake slashed; honest nodes whose roots replay clean keep seat weight.
